scientific_interpretation.A: Representation drift relative to the exact frontal reference.
scientific_interpretation.B: Top-1 retrieval consistency among complete expression sequences.
scientific_interpretation.C: Own-expression prototype margin over the strongest rival.
scientific_interpretation.key_test: Determine whether A/C boundaries systematically precede B prediction failure.

caution: The individual mathematical operations are standard. Novelty should be claimed from the controlled benchmark, trajectory-level analysis, critical viewpoint boundaries, and empirical findings—not from cosine similarity or numerical integration alone.
